import type { Tripwire } from './match.ts'

/**
 * The built-in tripwires: real mistakes, each with where it was learned.
 * Add your own in ~/.claude/tripwires.json (same shape, as an array or
 * { "tripwires": [...] }); they load alongside these.
 */
export const SEED: Tripwire[] = [
  {
    "id": "secret-in-command",
    "tool": "^Bash$",
    "field": "command",
    "pattern": "(sk_live_[A-Za-z0-9]{8,}|sk_test_[A-Za-z0-9]{8,}|sb_secret_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,}|eyJhbGciOi[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}\\.[A-Za-z0-9_-]{10,}|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|re_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{30,})",
    "severity": "block",
    "redact": true,
    "lesson": "A secret value is in the command text, so it lands in the transcript and shell history. Pipe it from the clipboard instead: pbpaste | <command> && pbcopy < /dev/null. Treat this one as leaked and rotate it.",
    "source": "a service_role key pasted as a wrangler secret NAME, 2026-10-04"
  },
  {
    "id": "deploy-verify-content",
    "tool": "^Bash$",
    "field": "command",
    "pattern": "(wrangler (pages )?deploy|npm run deploy)(?!:dry)",
    "unless": "--dry-run",
    "severity": "remind",
    "lesson": "After this deploy, verify on CONTENT, not the status code: curl the live URL and grep for text that only the new version contains.",
    "source": "false 'deployed' claims, twice, on a production app"
  },
  {
    "id": "kv-list-needs-remote",
    "tool": "^Bash$",
    "field": "command",
    "pattern": "wrangler kv key (list|get)",
    "unless": "--remote",
    "severity": "remind",
    "lesson": "Without --remote, wrangler reads the LOCAL dev store and returns []. A working form looks broken.",
    "source": "half an hour lost on a client site"
  },
  {
    "id": "apps-script-redirect",
    "tool": "^Bash$",
    "field": "command",
    "pattern": "curl(?=.*script\\.google(usercontent)?\\.com)(?=.*(-X POST|--post30[123]))",
    "severity": "remind",
    "lesson": "Apps Script answers 302 to an echo URL that must be fetched with GET. Use curl -sL -d '...' with no -X POST and no --post302, or you get a fake 'Page Not Found'.",
    "source": "a sheet sync check, 2026-10-04"
  },
  {
    "id": "migration-in-transaction",
    "tool": "^Bash$",
    "field": "command",
    "pattern": "(psql|wrangler d1 execute|supabase db).*(drop |delete from|update |alter table)",
    "unless": "begin",
    "severity": "ask",
    "lesson": "A schema or data change that isn't wrapped in begin/commit can stop half-way and leave damage (a notes move once blanked notes it hadn't copied). Wrap it.",
    "source": "production migrations, 2026-10-03"
  },
  {
    "id": "no-claude-attribution",
    "tool": "^Bash$",
    "field": "command",
    "pattern": "git commit[\\s\\S]*(Co-Authored-By: Claude|Generated with \\[?Claude Code)",
    "severity": "block",
    "lesson": "No Claude attribution in this user's commits: no Co-Authored-By trailer, no 'Generated with Claude Code'.",
    "source": "standing preference"
  },
  {
    "id": "commit-only-when-asked",
    "tool": "^Bash$",
    "field": "command",
    "pattern": "git commit",
    "severity": "remind",
    "lesson": "Only commit when the user asked for THIS commit. An earlier 'commit everything' does not cover later changes.",
    "source": "a follow-up fix committed unasked, 2026-10-04"
  },
  {
    "id": "outbound-email-strangers",
    "tool": "^Bash$",
    "field": "command",
    "pattern": "(send-smtp\\.py|api\\.resend\\.com/emails|generate-outreach)",
    "severity": "ask",
    "lesson": "This path emails real strangers. Never trigger it as a side effect of another task.",
    "source": "standing rule"
  },
  {
    "id": "assets-dir-not-root",
    "tool": "^(Edit|Write|MultiEdit)$",
    "pattern": "\"directory\"\\s*:\\s*\"\\./?\"",
    "severity": "block",
    "lesson": "assets.directory must be a subfolder. Pointing it at the repo root uploads .git and serves the whole history publicly.",
    "source": "lead-site template"
  },
  {
    "id": "sheet-formula-injection",
    "tool": "^(Edit|Write|MultiEdit)$",
    "pattern": "appendRow\\(",
    "unless": "asText|sheetSafe",
    "severity": "remind",
    "lesson": "Google Sheets runs any cell starting with = + - @ as a formula. Prefix client-supplied text with ' before appendRow.",
    "source": "a security review, 2026-10-04"
  },
  {
    "id": "gmail-compose-swallows-keys",
    "tool": "claude-in-chrome__navigate$",
    "field": "url",
    "pattern": "mail\\.google\\.com.*view=cm",
    "severity": "remind",
    "lesson": "In Gmail compose, the first keystrokes after page load are swallowed. Type the recipient in a separate step and zoom to verify the To field before moving on.",
    "source": "10 contractor drafts, 2026-10-04"
  },
  {
    "id": "supabase-host-unreachable",
    "tool": "^Bash$",
    "field": "command",
    "pattern": "[a-z0-9]{20}\\.supabase\\.co",
    "severity": "remind",
    "lesson": "If the project host doesn't resolve (ENOTFOUND), a free Supabase project has probably PAUSED from inactivity. Restore it in the dashboard; it isn't your code.",
    "source": "a production outage, 2026-10-03"
  }
]
